limits.connections: A workflow holds at most {max} connections.
limits.definitionSize: This workflow is larger than 1 MiB.

triggerFields.forEachStatementDescription: One run per write, with the list of rows - {path}.
triggerFields.filterInvalid: Must be a JSON filter object.
triggerFields.tableDescription: The table whose changes admit a run, or the function whose calls do.
triggerFields.eventsDescription: At least one event that triggers this workflow.
triggerFields.forEachDescription: Like a PostgreSQL trigger's FOR EACH ROW / FOR EACH STATEMENT: a bulk write of 500 rows starts 500 runs, or one run with the 500 rows.
triggerFields.filterDescription: Optional - only rows matching it (the resulting row; the deleted one on Delete). The one filter grammar, e.g. {example}.
triggerFields.changedFieldsDescription: Optional, Update only - runs only when one of these columns changed.
triggerFields.oldFilterDescription: Optional, Update only - the row before the write must match it, e.g. {example} with Filter status PAID: runs on PENDING -> PAID.
triggerFields.executeAsDataEvent: The data change that admits a run has its own author, but the workflow itself always runs as this account - not as whoever made the change.
triggerFields.executeAsManual: Empty: whoever runs it. A user chosen here: every run executes as them, while the caller is still recorded as who started it - invoking it stays gated by its roles.
triggerFields.inputFormDescription: Optional - the fields a caller fills in (Run shows them as a form). A run's input is checked against them: required ones present, each of its type. None: any input is taken.
triggerFields.inputFieldsHelp: Each field: its name - the key the workflow reads in its Start data - a label and a type.
triggerFields.confirmationDescription: Optional - asked before Run starts it, e.g. 'This sends an email to every customer.'
triggerFields.timezoneDescription: IANA time zone used to interpret the schedule.
triggerFields.executeAsCron: A scheduled run has no authenticated caller - a specific user is required.
triggerFields.methodDescription: The HTTP method the external caller must use to invoke this endpoint.
triggerFields.responseDescription: Synchronous waits for the workflow result. Asynchronous accepts the request and continues in the background.
triggerFields.waitTimeDescription: Seconds to wait for a result before applying the timeout action - never more than Settings › Features › Workflows › Maximum synchronous wait.
triggerFields.onTimeoutDescription: What happens when the wait time elapses without a result.
triggerFields.accessDescription: Authenticated requires a valid identity with invocation permission. Public requires an explicit execution user.
triggerFields.executeAsWebhookPublic: Required - a public webhook has an anonymous initiator and must use a specific execution user.
triggerFields.executeAsWebhookAuthenticated: Optional - defaults to the authenticated caller when left unset.
triggerFields.functionCall: Each call to this function through the Data API starts one run, after it commits: its arguments in {args}, what it returned in {result}. A workflow's own Execute function step doesn't start one. To act only on some calls, add a Condition after Start.

cron.previewFailed: Could not compute a preview for this schedule.
cron.monthsDescription: Leave every month selected to run each month.
cron.expressionDescription: 5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Months JAN-DEC and weekdays SUN-SAT may be named, e.g. {example}

conditionModal.configureTheBranchThisNode: Configure the branch this node evaluates.
conditionModal.anyJsonValueTheFilter: Any JSON value the filter below evaluates. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
conditionModal.evaluatedAgainstTheInputAbove: Evaluated against the input above. Uses the same filter grammar as row filters and Data API where[...] - a value can also use {c0}.

createFileModal.storeGeneratedContentAsA: Store generated content as a new Asset.
createFileModal.whereTheFileIsStored: Where the file is stored. None: the root.
createFileModal.base64BinaryContentFromAnother: Base64: binary content from another step, e.g. a PDF.
createFileModal.theAssetSContentText: The Asset's content - text, or base64 when Encoding says so. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).

createRecordsModal.insertOneOrMoreRecords: Insert one or more records into a resource using the same rules as an ordinary Data API request.
createRecordsModal.onlyActiveTableResourcesWritable: Only active TABLE resources writable (POST) by the executing principal.
createRecordsModal.aJsonArrayOneObject: A JSON array - one object per record to insert. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}), array items with {c2}.
createRecordsModal.letThisStepSInserts: Let this step's inserts count as a database-event trigger for OTHER workflows - off by default. Immutable causal-ancestry tracking (at most Settings > Workflows > Maximum chain depth workflows deep, no repeats) prevents an accidental loop.

deleteRecordsModal.deleteASelectionUsingThe: Delete a selection using the same rules as an ordinary Data API request.
deleteRecordsModal.onlyActiveTableResourcesWritable: Only active TABLE resources writable (DELETE) by the executing principal.
deleteRecordsModal.whichRowsToDeleteRequired: Which rows to delete. Required unless the setting 'Require a filter for bulk delete' is off - then empty matches every row. A filter value can reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
deleteRecordsModal.letThisStepSDeletions: Let this step's deletions count as a database-event trigger for OTHER workflows - off by default. Immutable causal-ancestry tracking (at most Settings > Workflows > Maximum chain depth workflows deep, no repeats) prevents an accidental loop.

editor.restoredDescription: Nothing is published yet - publish to make it live.
editor.copyCreatedDescription: An unpublished copy - publish it when ready.
editor.publishBeforeEnabling: Publish this workflow before enabling it.
editor.settingsUpdateFailed: Could not update the workflow settings
editor.publishDescription: Saves the canvas as-is, then makes it the version every new run of this workflow uses.
editor.deleteDescription: Its design, every version and its run history are removed. This can't be undone. Records it already created in your own tables are NOT deleted.
editor.disabledHint: Disabled - no trigger admits a run. Enable it in Settings › General.
editor.runTestDescription: The draft as it is. Its effects are real.

executeFunctionModal.invokeAPostgresqlFunctionExposed: Invoke a PostgreSQL function exposed by a resource.
executeFunctionModal.onlyActiveFunctionResourcesInvokable: Only active FUNCTION resources invokable (POST) by the executing principal.
executeFunctionModal.aJsonObjectArgumentNames: A JSON object - argument names mapped to their values. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).

executeJavascriptModal.customLogicTransformationRunAs: Custom logic/transformation, run as its own step.
executeJavascriptModal.runsInAnIsolatedSandbox: Runs in an isolated sandbox with `trigger` and `results` (prior steps' data) available - no filesystem/network/process access. Must return plain JSON data.

executeSqlModal.runsARawStatementNo: Runs a raw statement - no permission checks, only audit attribution.
executeSqlModal.thisStatementRunsDirectlyIt: This statement runs directly - it does not go through role/permission enforcement like the Data API or other steps. Anyone who can edit this workflow can add or change it.
executeSqlModal.recordedForAuditPurposesOnly: Recorded for audit purposes only - it does not restrict what the statement can do. Empty, the run's own user.

executeWorkflowModal.passedAsTheInvokedWorkflow: Passed as the invoked workflow's own trigger data. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).

finishErrorModal.stopTheRunWithA: Stop the run with a defined error - a terminal step, nothing runs after it.
finishErrorModal.referenceAnotherStepSResult: Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
finishErrorModal.optionalAShortMachineReadable: Optional - a short machine-readable error code. For example: INVALID_ORDER

finishResultModal.stopTheRunWithAn: Stop the run with an explicit result - a terminal step, nothing runs after it.
finishResultModal.anyJsonValueReferenceAnother: Any JSON value. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).

forEachModal.runTheBodyOncePer: Run the body once per element of a list.
forEachModal.mustResolveToAJson: Must resolve to a JSON array at run time. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
forEachModal.wireThisStepSItem: Wire this step's "Item" output to the first step of the body, and "Done" to whatever runs after the loop finishes. Inside the body, reference the current element with {c0} (e.g. {c1}).

generateFileModal.aJsonArrayObjectTo: A JSON array/object to serialize (CSV format expects an array of objects). Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).

generatePdfModal.buildAPdfFromA: Build a PDF from a custom pdfme design.
generatePdfModal.aPdfmeDesignObjectBasepdf: A pdfme design object (basePdf + schemas) - the same shape a PDF Template stores.
generatePdfModal.aJsonObjectValuesFor: A JSON object - values for the design's placeholders.

generatePdfTemplateModal.fillASavedPdfmeTemplate: Fill a saved pdfme template's placeholders.
generatePdfTemplateModal.aPdfTemplateFromThe: A PDF template from the Templates module.
generatePdfTemplateModal.aJsonObjectValuesFor: A JSON object - values for the template's placeholders.

httpRequestModal.anHttpOrHttpsUrl: An http or https URL. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}). Private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused unless listed in Settings > Workflows.
httpRequestModal.aJsonObjectHeaderNames: A JSON object - header names mapped to their values. A value can use {c0} too.
httpRequestModal.headersWhoseValueIsA: Headers whose value is a secret from Settings > Secrets - read when the step runs, never stored in the workflow or its history (an Authorization token, an API key).
httpRequestModal.sentAsTheRequestBody: Sent as the request body (ignored for GET/DELETE/HEAD/OPTIONS). Any JSON value - a string that's exactly one {c0} expression resolves to the real typed value.

soapRequestModal.callASoapWebService: Call one operation of a SOAP web service.
soapRequestModal.theServiceEndpoint: The service's endpoint (not its WSDL), an http or https URL. {c0} is supported. Private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused unless listed in Settings > Workflows.
soapRequestModal.theOperationsElementName: The operation's element name, as the WSDL names it - FECAESolicitar, getPersona.
soapRequestModal.theOperationsXmlNamespace: The operation's XML namespace, from the WSDL's targetNamespace.
soapRequestModal.theSoapActionHeader: The SOAPAction the WSDL declares for the operation. Leave it empty when the WSDL declares an empty one.
soapRequestModal.aJsonObjectTheParameters: A JSON object - the operation's parameters, turned into XML by the server. A key is an element name, an array repeats the element, null leaves it out. A value can use {c0}.
soapRequestModal.elementsAlwaysReadAsAList: Element names of the response always read as a list, comma-separated - so a step reads the same shape whether the service answered one or many.
soapRequestModal.aJsonObjectSentInTheEnvelopesHeader: A JSON object sent in the envelope's Header, the same way as the body. A value can use {c0}.
soapRequestModal.aJsonObjectHttpHeaderNames: A JSON object - HTTP header names mapped to their values. A value can use {c0}.
soapRequestModal.httpHeadersWhoseValueIsA: HTTP headers whose value is a secret from Settings > Secrets - read when the step runs, never stored in the workflow or its history.

signModal.signDataWithAStoredCertificate: Sign a text with a certificate and its private key, or a key, from Settings > Secrets.
signModal.cmsDescription: CMS / PKCS#7 SignedData: the text attached, the certificate included, SHA-256, DER in base64 - what openssl cms -sign produces and a WSAA login takes.
signModal.theTextToSign: The text to sign, usually built by an earlier step: {c0}.
signModal.aSecretHoldingThePemCertificate: The secret holding the certificate, in PEM (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----).
signModal.aSecretHoldingThePemKey: The secret holding the certificate's private key, in PEM. An RSA key.
signModal.onlyWhenTheKeyIsEncrypted: Only when the private key is encrypted: the secret holding its passphrase.
signModal.hmacDescription: HMAC-SHA256: a keyed hash of the text with a secret as its key - a webhook's signature, or a pseudonym only that secret can recompute.
signModal.aSecretHoldingTheKey: The secret holding the key, used as text.
signModal.encodingDescription: How the signature is written: hexadecimal (lowercase) or base64.

parseFileModal.convertAFileSContent: Convert a File's content into data.
parseFileModal.aFileIdReferenceAnother: A File id. Reference another step's result with {c0} (e.g. {c1}).

processBatchesModal.splitACollectionIntoFixed: Split a collection into fixed-size batches.
processBatchesModal.mustResolveToAJson: Must resolve to a JSON array - split into batches of the configured size. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
processBatchesModal.wireThisStepSBatch: Wire this step's "Batch" output to the first step of the body, and "Done" to whatever runs after every batch finishes. Inside the body, reference the current batch with {c0} (e.g. {c1}).

readFileModal.aFileIdReferenceAnother: A File id. Reference another step's result with {c0} (e.g. {c1}).

readRecordsModal.queryAResourceUsingThe: Query a resource using the same rules as an ordinary Data API request.
readRecordsModal.onlyActiveTableViewResources: Only active TABLE/VIEW resources readable by the executing principal.
readRecordsModal.fieldsFilterSearchGroupingOrdering: Fields, filter, search, grouping, ordering, limit/offset. A filter value can reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).

selectCaseModal.branchOnTheFirstMatching: Branch on the first matching case, in order.
selectCaseModal.anyJsonValueEachCase: Any JSON value each case's filter below evaluates. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
selectCaseModal.catchesAnyInputThatMatched: Catches any input that matched no case above. Without it, an unmatched input fails this step (follows its Error output, if wired).
selectCaseModal.evaluatedInOrderTheFirst: Evaluated in order - the first case whose filter matches wins. Reorder with the arrows. Each case has a name (for example: high_value) that later steps branch on.
selectCaseModal.caseNamePattern: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore - must start with a letter.

sendEmailModal.commaSeparatedRecipientAddressesReferenc: Comma-separated recipient addresses. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
sendEmailModal.whereRepliesToThisMessage: Where replies to this message should go, if different from the sender.
sendEmailModal.anEmailTemplateFromTemplates: An email template from Templates. The workflow's executor needs READ on it.
sendEmailModal.aJsonObjectWithA: A JSON object with a value for every {c0} the template's subject and message use (nested fields as {c1}). A missing one fails the step. Values may reference another step's result with {c2}.
sendEmailModal.subject: Subject
sendEmailModal.fileIdsOrAnotherStep: File ids, or another step's result with {c0} (e.g. {c1}). The executor needs READ on each file; at most 10, 20 MB together.
sendEmailModal.textBodyDescription: Plain-text fallback for clients that cannot render HTML.

updateRecordsModal.modifyASelectionUsingThe: Modify a selection using the same rules as an ordinary Data API request.
updateRecordsModal.onlyActiveTableResourcesWritable: Only active TABLE resources writable (PATCH) by the executing principal.
updateRecordsModal.whichRowsToUpdateRequired: Which rows to update. Required unless the setting 'Require a filter for bulk update' is off - then empty matches every row. A filter value can reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
updateRecordsModal.aJsonObjectColumnNames: A JSON object - column names mapped to their new values. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
updateRecordsModal.letThisStepSUpdates: Let this step's updates count as a database-event trigger for OTHER workflows - off by default. Immutable causal-ancestry tracking (at most Settings > Workflows > Maximum chain depth workflows deep, no repeats) prevents an accidental loop.

validateDataModal.checkAValueAgainstRules: Check a value against rules - continues on Success, or fails with every broken rule's message.
validateDataModal.anyJsonValueTheRules: Any JSON value the rules below check. Reference another step's result with {c0} (Start included, as {c1}).
validateDataModal.mustMatchTheInputA: Must match the input. A value can also use {c0}.
validateDataModal.reportedWhenThisRuleFails: Reported when this rule fails. Empty reports 'Rule N failed.'
validateDataModal.eachRuleIsAFilter: Each rule is a filter over the input - the same grammar as row filters and Data API where[...]. Every rule must hold; each one that doesn't reports its message.

waitResumeModal.suspendTheRunForA: Suspend the run for a fixed time before continuing.
waitResumeModal.secondsToSuspendBeforeThe: Seconds to suspend before the next step runs.

workflowHistoryFields.offARunIsKept: Off: a run is kept only 24 hours after it finishes, for a workflow whose runs needn't be kept.
workflowHistoryFields.summaryRecordsExecutedStepsDetailed: Summary records executed steps; Detailed also retains permitted inputs and results.

workflowInvokeRolesField.rolesThatMayInvokeThis: Roles that may invoke this workflow
workflowInvokeRolesField.administratorsCanAlwaysInvokeAny: Administrators can always invoke any workflow. With no role allowed, only they can.
workflowInvokeRolesField.onlyMattersForManualCron: Only matters for Manual and Schedule triggers and authenticated webhooks
workflowInvokeRolesField.aDataEventTriggerNever: A Data event trigger never checks this - it always runs as its own configured user, regardless of who caused the underlying mutation.

workflowRunModal.anyJsonValueTheRun: Any JSON value - the run reads it as {c0}, as a Manual trigger's caller would send it.
workflowRunModal.testDescription: Runs the saved draft as you - a real run: its writes and side effects happen. Marked TEST; nothing is published or enabled.
workflowRunModal.scheduledDescription: Runs the published version{version} now, exactly as its schedule would: as its execution user, with the schedule data ({path}, started_at, timezone) as input.
workflowRunModal.productionDescription: Runs the published version{version} in production - as you, or as its Execute as user.
workflowRunModal.draftNotSavedReason: The draft could not be saved, so it was not run: {reason}
workflowRunModal.draftNotSaved: The draft could not be saved, so it was not run.
workflowRunModal.sendEmailsToHelp: Optional. Every email this test run sends goes only to this address instead of its recipients - cc and bcc included. Empty: the steps' own recipients.

workflowStepCard.deleteWithDownstream: Delete "{title}" and {n} downstream step? | Delete "{title}" and {n} downstream steps?
workflowStepCard.removesFollowing: This removes every step that follows it in the tree.
workflowStepCard.removesStep: This removes the step from the workflow.

workflowStepKeyField.shortIdOtherStepsUse: Short id other steps use to reference this one's output later. Letters, numbers, underscores only. For example: read_brands
workflowStepKeyField.reservedStart: "start" is reserved for the trigger step.
workflowStepKeyField.reservedItem: "item" is reserved for the current loop item in {expression} expressions.
workflowStepKeyField.reservedError: "error" is reserved for the handled error in {expression} expressions.

workflowTree.limitReached: A workflow holds at most {max} steps

trigger.title: Triggering event
trigger.description: What admits a run of this workflow.

access.title: Access
access.description: Which roles may invoke this workflow.

newModal.title: New workflow
newModal.description: The workflow is created before opening its visual editor.
newModal.notActivatedDescription: Publish it from the editor once its design is ready.

index.title: Select a workflow
index.description: Choose a workflow from the sidebar, or create a new one.

settings.appliesAtOnce: Changes on this tab apply at once - no Publish needed.
settings.appliesOnPublish: The trigger is versioned: a change reaches production on the next Publish.
settings.enabledHelp: Off, no trigger admits a run - the schedule, the data events and the webhook are silent; Test run still works.

runs.noSteps: No step history retained for this run.
runs.summaryHistory: This run kept Summary history - no input or result per step, so there is no detail to open. Set Detailed history (Settings › General) before running it to see this.
runs.cancelRequestedDescription: The run stops after the step in progress.
